title: 3D logo animation

title: Simple product animation

title: Product stills
scope: One simple product view using supplied geometry and material references.

title: 3D asset cleanup
scope: One simple prop: units, origin and normals check, neutral-format export and change notes.

title: Character animation loop
scope: One short idle or gesture on a supplied compatible rig.

title: Short animation retarget
scope: Transfer one supplied short action between two compatible humanoid rigs.

title: Short motion cleanup
scope: One short existing take: loop seam or contact correction.

title: Single-shot camera tracking
scope: A short footage suitability review followed by an agreed camera solve.

title: Simple video composite
scope: One straightforward overlay or screen replacement from supplied assets.

title: Short video edit

title: Subtitle text cleanup

title: Software demo script and shot list

title: One-page software product sheet

title: Simple SVG cleanup and recolor

title: Small media remux or extraction
scope: One supplied clip up to 100 MB, compatible stream copy or audio extraction; output and brief validation notes.

title: Quick-start or troubleshooting guide
scope: Up to 600 words from supplied sources, prerequisite checklist and one revision; Markdown or Google Doc.

title: Small Python fix or CSV utility
scope: One agreed reproducible issue or bounded CSV transformation, source code and relevant tests.
